note: Slicer estimates, not physical prints. Final variant combines OSM and Microsoft footprints, a finer feature raster, flat building roofs and protected minor-road cores. Includes the embedded location pin. Core four-colour print settings are unchanged; automatic tree-support generation is enabled, with no support toolpaths produced in the validated slice. Earlier measurements and optimization trials are historical; the intermediate dense OSM preview was not a validated print benchmark.
